newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CANTV to get rate rise in August.
newsitem.headline: CANTV to get rate rise in August.

text.p: Venezuelan national telephone company CANTV could receive a planned quarterly tariff rise of 1.98 percent in August, Transport and Communications Minister Moises Orozco Graterol said Tuesday.
"It could be in August," Orozco told reporters in Miraflores presidential palace.
The 1.98 percent third quarter rate rise was currently being studied by the National Telecommunications Chamber Conatel, Orozco said.
Once approved and published in the Official Gazette the rate rise would take 30 days to come into effect, he said.
Orozco stressed that the rate rise would only apply to national calls as CANTV continues its efforts to remove cross- subsidizing of local and long distance calls by international calls.
The delay in approving the rate rise, which should have gone into effect this month, was caused by CANTV's delay in presenting its cost structure for evaluation.
CANTV's last rate rise was 4.18 percent in April.
